The seasonal zone indicates the yamadori window (150–400 °d). The transition label summarizes phenology — use it as a guide, not certainty.

privacy_data_cadastre_body: Cached locally. Coordinates sent to national cadastre / protected-area services when enabled. Not shared. Deletion: Settings → clear cadastre cache.
privacy_data_location_body: Stored on device (trees, parking, position). Sent online: latitude/longitude only, to enabled APIs. Shareable via export or tree sharing. Deletion: delete the tree or clear caches in Settings.
privacy_data_map_body: Cached locally. Tile requests for the visible map area by country (IGN, CNIG, basemap.de, OS…). Not shared. Deletion: Settings → clear map cache.
privacy_data_photos_body: Stored on device. Never sent online by Yamadori. Shareable via export or tree sharing. Deletion: delete the tree.
privacy_data_voice_body: Stored on device. Never sent online. Shareable via backup export only. Deletion: delete the tree.
privacy_data_weather_body: Cached locally after a request. Coordinates sent to Open-Meteo when that API is enabled. Not shared. Deletion: Settings → clear weather cache.
privacy_intro: Yamadori does not sync your scouting entries to the cloud. Your field notebook lives in your pocket.
privacy_inventory_intro: What Yamadori handles for your field notebook — where it is stored, what goes online and how to delete it.
privacy_pillar_api_controls_body: Each network connection can be disabled individually in Settings. If you turn off an API, no more live requests; already downloaded cache remains available offline.
privacy_pillar_backup_body: Export a backup regularly (USB drive, personal cloud). Without an export password, the file only ensures integrity (checksums) — not confidentiality: anyone with the file can extract the data. With a password, the entire archive is encrypted (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM). The hint is a memory aid only; it cannot recover the password.
privacy_pillar_gps_body: In the foreground, GPS is used to scout a tree, display the map and contextualise weather. Tracking stops when the app is in the background. No location is sent to a server.
privacy_pillar_honest_body: Like a paper notebook in your bag, your scouting entries remain readable on an unlocked device. Yamadori does not use Android automatic backup to Google. We recommend a screen lock and password-protected exports.
privacy_pillar_local_body: No account, no Yamadori server. Your scouting entries, photos, voice notes and starting point stay on this device. By default, data is stored unencrypted in local memory; you can enable local encryption in Settings (optional, Android) — it protects trees, parking, export password and GPS settings, but not weather or map caches.
privacy_pillar_network_body: When online, only your GPS coordinates are sent to public services for weather, agronomy, maps, cadastre, protected areas and geocoding — never your photos or notes. Services used by country include Open-Meteo, IGN / CNIG / basemap.de / OS / swisstopo / basemap.at / OpenTopo (BE) / PDOK BRT (NL) / OpenTopo (SE) / Kartverket (NO), EEA, Natural England, FOEN, CadGIS, Nominatim (OpenStreetMap), and others.
privacy_pillar_no_tracking_body: No Yamadori account, no ads, no analytics (Firebase, crash reporters, etc.). No data resale. No third-party cookies: the app runs locally in an Android WebView.
privacy_pillar_offline_body: Map, weather and cadastre data are cached locally. GPS works without a network — even deep in the woods.
privacy_pillar_permissions_body: Camera: tree photos only, when you tap Capture. Microphone: voice notes (30 s max), on your action. Location: scouting, map and weather, only while the app is in the foreground. Compass: heading during capture, processed locally. The permissions wizard on first launch guides you — nothing is requested without reason.
privacy_pillar_share_body: Sharing a tree or exporting a backup is entirely your choice. Nothing is sent to third parties automatically.
privacy_pillar_share_title: You decide who sees your spots
privacy_pillar_third_parties_body: Open-Meteo (forecasts and climate history; commercial use under the publisher’s subscription), national maps (IGN FR, CNIG ES, basemap.de, Ordnance Survey / OSM fallback, swisstopo CH, basemap.at AT, OpenTopo BE, PDOK BRT NL, OpenTopo SE, Kartverket NO), cadastre (IGN Apicarto, Catastro ES, Catasto IT, partial ALKIS DE, HMLR GB, AV/EGRID CH + ZH AVWFS, AT municipality, CadGIS BE, BRK NL, kommun SE, matrikkel NO), protected areas (IGN FR, EEA, Natural England, FOEN/Pro Natura CH), Nominatim/OpenStreetMap (place labels), municipal directories by country. Yamadori has no intermediary server: your coordinates go directly to these public services, each with its own privacy policy. Your photos and notes never leave the device this way.

veto_check_disclaimer: I have read this clause and understand that information is provided for guidance only, without liability on the part of the publisher.
veto_check_property: I certify that I hold written, signed authorization from the owner of this parcel (private owner, town hall, or ONF agreement).
veto_check_property_forbidden: I acknowledge that this land type is generally forbidden or strictly regulated, and that I checked with the competent authority — indicative only.
veto_check_property_owner: I certify that I obtained written authorization from the owner (private party, municipality or land manager) for this parcel — indicative only, not legal validation.
veto_check_property_permit: I certify that I started or obtained the required permit process with the competent authority or agency — indicative only.
veto_check_protected_area: I certify that the parcel is not in a regulated protected area.
veto_check_restoration: I commit to filling the extraction hole with original soil and restoring the ground to its initial appearance.
veto_check_species: I certify that I checked the official database and this species is not among protected plant species (national and regional orders).
veto_check_species_caution: I certify that I verified the official source despite the alert, and that collecting this species is permitted here.
veto_disclaimer_body: Protected zoning, cadastral data, legal references and external links shown in this app are provided for information only. They do not constitute legal advice, collection permission or a guarantee of accuracy. The Yamadori publisher cannot be held liable for any error, omission, outdated source data or interpretation. You remain solely responsible for checking applicable regulations with the competent authorities before any collection.
veto_disclaimer_country_note: Context: {country}. Texts and links are indicative for this country; local rules (municipality, canton, state, province) may differ.
veto_disclaimer_note_at: Austria: species and forest rules are largely Land-level. RIS and the biodiversity atlas are indicative.
veto_disclaimer_note_be: Belgium: regional competence (Wallonia, Flanders, Brussels). Check the authority for the relevant region.
veto_disclaimer_note_ca: Canada: federal / provincial / territorial competence. Permit links are starting points only.
veto_disclaimer_note_ch: Switzerland: forests and nature are mainly cantonal (FOEN / cantonal services). Cadastre.ch does not grant authorization.
veto_disclaimer_note_de: Germany: forest and nature-protection law is mainly Land-level. Check the relevant Land forestry / nature authority.
veto_disclaimer_note_es: Spain: competence is largely regional (autonomous communities). MITECO and the national cadastre do not authorize collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_fr: France: competence is often municipal (mairie) and, in public forest, ONF / local authority. National texts do not replace local rules.
veto_disclaimer_note_gb: United Kingdom: competence by nation (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland). Listed hubs are starting points only.
veto_disclaimer_note_it: Italy: national frameworks (Normattiva) plus regional / local rules. Species portals and MASE are indicative.
veto_disclaimer_note_nl: Netherlands: nature permits often via RVO / land manager (e.g. Staatsbosbeheer). Links are starting points only.
veto_disclaimer_note_no: Norway: Miljødirektoratet / Landbruksdirektoratet and municipalities. Indicative only.
veto_disclaimer_note_nz: New Zealand: DOC and local authorities depending on land status. Links are starting points only.
veto_disclaimer_note_pt: Portugal: ICNF / DGT and local authorities. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_se: Sweden: Skogsstyrelsen / Naturvårdsverket and local rules. Indicative only.
veto_disclaimer_note_us: United States: federal / state / local competence depending on tenure (USFS, BLM, state…). Permit links are starting points only.
veto_guidance_forbidden: Indicative: collection is generally forbidden on this land type. Check with the competent authority — not legal advice.
veto_guidance_forbidden_or_agency: Indicative: forbidden or strictly agency-controlled. Contact the manager before any collection.
veto_guidance_owner_permission: Indicative: private or similar land — owner permission (via town hall / registry / manager) is essential.
veto_guidance_permit_required: Indicative: a permit or agency authorization is usually required. Use the links below to start the process.
veto_guidance_unknown: Indicative: ambiguous tenure. Do not assume private or open — verify with local authorities.
veto_law_cc547_text: "The natural or industrial fruits of the land [...] belong to the owner by right of accession."
veto_law_cc552_text: "Ownership of the land carries ownership of what is above and below it." This includes trees, shrubs, and the soil/substrate taken with the root ball.
veto_law_ce_l411_1_text: Prohibits "destruction, cutting, mutilation, uprooting, picking or removal" of protected plant species — even with the landowner's consent.
veto_law_ce_l415_3_text: Criminal provisions: harming protected plant species — offence punishable by 3 years' imprisonment and €150,000 fine.
veto_law_cf_l161_1_text: Punishes degradation of forest soils or tracks — hence the obligation to fill the hole and restore the ground.
veto_law_cf_l331_2_text: Severely punishes unauthorized uprooting or cutting. Fines are based on volume or tree count; equipment used (vehicle, shovels, picks) may be confiscated.
veto_law_cp311_1_text: "Theft is the fraudulent taking of another's property." Removing a tree without the owner's explicit consent (public or private) is legally theft.
veto_law_generic_text: Indicative summary — check the official text via the link. This is not legal advice.
veto_law_property_heading: A. Property law (Civil Code & Penal Code)
veto_mairie_contact: Contact {name} with parcel {parcel} about the access-authorisation process.
veto_mairie_loading: Looking up town hall contact details…
veto_mairie_unavailable: Town hall contact unavailable — search for "town hall of {commune}".
veto_property_intro: In France, the tree belongs to the owner of the land where it germinated.
veto_property_intro_ca: In Canada, legality depends on the province and land type (private, Crown, park…). Yamadori detects protected areas via CPCAD — not all Crown land.
veto_property_intro_generic: The tree generally belongs to whoever holds rights over the land where it germinated — access and collection authorisation is required.
veto_property_intro_nz: In New Zealand, collecting plants on DOC public conservation land needs authorisation. Outside DOC PCL, verify private / Māori / other Crown tenure — Yamadori does not map all land.
veto_property_intro_us: In the U.S., legality depends on the landowner and land type (private, BLM, National Forest, park…). Yamadori detects public tenure via PAD-US — not private parcels.
veto_scan_cached: Result from local cache (area already scanned or offline mode).
veto_scan_clear: No national park or national nature reserve detected at this GPS point.
veto_scan_offline_miss: Offline and no cache for this point — reconnect to scan protected areas, or check manually.
veto_scan_partial_coverage: Partial protected-area coverage for this country: no hit does not mean the area is unrestricted.
veto_species_examples_body: Order of 20 January 1982 (non-exhaustive): Dwarf birch (Betula nana), Salzmann pine (Pinus nigra subsp. salzmannii), some wild willows (Salix lapponum, S. repens…), Daphne species.
veto_species_inpn_body: Before any harvest, check on the official {source} database that the species is not protected. If it is listed as protected, taking it may be an offence even with the landowner's consent.
veto_species_regional_generic: Over 400 species are nationally protected, and hundreds more regionally. Always check INPN — do not rely on a fixed in-app list.
veto_species_regional_pdl: Pays de la Loire region detected (GPS): subject to the 25 January 1993 order. Wetlands, heathland and coastal dunes (Gâvre, Loire hillsides, marshes) have many strictly protected species.
veto_tenure_forbidden_warn: Warning: tenure indicator is “forbidden”. This does not hard-block confirmation — verify with the competent authority before any collection.
veto_zone_appb_hint: Strict habitat protection — check prefectural orders.
veto_zone_appb_manual: No national coverage — check prefectural orders for your department.
veto_zone_doc_conservation_hint: DOC permit required — rarely granted for yamadori.
veto_zone_natura_hint: Subject to impact assessment or specific prefectural order.
veto_zone_outside_pcl_hint: May be private, Māori, or other Crown — verify before collecting.
veto_zone_pnr_hint: Park charter — check local rules before any collection.
veto_zone_rnr_regional_hint: Regional, Corsican or hunting reserves — constraints vary by order.

veto_zone_status_potential: Your cadastral parcel may overlap this zone.
veto_zone_whenua_rahui_hint: No collecting without the governing authority.
veto_zone_znieff_hint: Ecological interest zone — check local constraints.
